Gothita

Psychic

Unova · Generation 5

Gothita is a Psychic-type Fixation Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5.8 kg. It evolves into Gothorita. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (65), with a base stat total of 290.
